name: Supply/demand zone retest: 2.5x body impulse, 0.3% retest, wick rejection
author: 4sightops (portfolio-agentic-trader)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: Candle body, 20-bar mean body, wick geometry
entry_long: Impulse = latest candle with body > 2.5 x 20-bar mean body (history excluding current bar). Zone level = impulse candle open. Demand (up impulse): if current close is within 0.3% of the zone and the current candle lower wick exceeds its body (hammer), BUY.
entry_short: Supply (down impulse): close within 0.3% of zone and upper wick > body (shooting star) -> SELL.
exit: No exit defined in the strategy module (signal generator only).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Zone is single price level (impulse open), not a rectangle; only the latest impulse is tracked; no exits so incomplete.
